pages.title: Security
pages.text: $(bold)DUTY LOG$()$(br)Hale, M., security$(br2)Why I am here: regulations want an armed post at the cradle. One officer, one sidearm. I was cheap and I could stay awake.

Nobody said what the sidearm is for. There is nothing down here but the cradle, that CS-1 unit and us.$(br2)I asked which way I was meant to face. The supervisor laughed, then stopped.$(br2)Away from the door, they said.
